title: The Household's Standing With the Collective and the Daily Figure on Late Equipment Rental and Demo Kit
content:
A household that skis the collective's mountains all winter is not treated as a stranger when its kit comes back late, and the daily figure the overdue days are charged at is taken at a share of itself.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account carries at least 8 lift scans in the four months before the fee is worked out, the daily figure is taken at the regular skier share of itself. The regular skier share is 55 per cent.

Where the household holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season and the pass account carries fewer than 8 lift scans in those four months, the daily figure is taken at the passholder share of itself instead. The passholder share is 80 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

## The conditions in combination

| Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season | Lift scans on the pass account in the four months before the fee is worked out | Share of the daily figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 8 or more | 55 per cent |
| yes | 7 or fewer | 80 per cent |
| no pass, or a pass not standing active | not counted | nothing under this heading |

The scan count of 8 is met by 8 scans and not by 7. Where no pass of the household stands active for the season, the scans are not weighed at all, however many the pass account shows.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement whose daily figure stands at 28.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The household holds a pass standing active for the season and the pass account shows 14 lift scans inside the four months: the daily figure is 55 per cent of 28.00 USD, which is 15.40 USD.
- The household holds a pass standing active for the season and the pass account shows 3 lift scans inside the four months: the daily figure is 80 per cent of 28.00 USD, which is 22.40 USD.
- The household's pass for the season does not stand active: nothing under this heading changes the 28.00 USD.

## Points of judgement

**The window.** The four months are counted back from the day the fee is worked out, so lift scans older than that fall outside the count although they stand on the pass account.

**The standing of the pass.** What is read is a pass of the household standing active for the season the agreement belongs to. A pass standing in any other state does not open either share.
